'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''

**[[Southern Syria clashes (July 2025–present)|Southern Syria clashes]]
***[[urban warfare|Street-to-street fighting]] in [[Suwayda]], [[Syria]], is reported between local [[Druze in Syria|Druze]] forces and pro-government [[Bedouin]] tribesmen. *[[M23 campaign (2022–present)|M23 campaign]]
**The [[March 23 Movement|M23]] paramilitary group and the [[government of the Democratic Republic of the Congo]] sign a declaration of principles stating that a full [[ceasefire]] and final peace agreement will be signed no later than August 18, and that it will be aligned with the earlier [[2025 Democratic Republic of the Congo–Rwanda peace agreement|DR Congo–Rwanda agreement]]. [https://www.cnn.com/2025/07/19/africa/congo-rwanda-m23-rebels-ceasefire-intl (CNN)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[Sinking of the Wonder Sea|Sinking of the ''Wonder Sea'']]
**At least 38 people are killed, 11 are rescued and eight others are reported missing, including children, when a storm causes the tourist boat ''Wonder Sea'' to capsize in the [[Hạ Long Bay]] in [[Quảng Ninh province]], [[Vietnam]]. [https://www.news18.com/world/at-least-34-killed-children-among-tourists-missing-as-boat-capsizes-in-vietnams-ha-long-bay-ws-l-9451165.html (News18)]
*At least 21 people are killed and 34 others are injured after a bus overturns and crashes in [[Kavar]], [[Fars province]], [[Iran]]. [https://www.newarab.com/news/bus-crash-kills-least-21-injures-34-south-iran (The New Arab)]
*Eight people are killed and six others are injured when a truck [[Traffic collision|collides]] with two passenger vans in [[Aurora, Isabela|Aurora]], [[Isabela (province)|Isabela province]], [[Philippines]]. [https://english.news.cn/20250719/579f69ee4bd4401099922e6bbc56d746/c.html (Xinhua)] [https://mb.com.ph/2025/07/19/8-killed-4-injured-in-3-vehicle-crash-in-isabela (''Manila Bulletin'')]
